invariants.rationale: The method always returns a HoodieSavepointMetadata object created by SavepointActionExecutor.execute(), so result is unlikely to be null.
A savepoint is created for a specific instant, so the instant identifier should be a non-empty string.
The user creating the savepoint should be specified and non-empty.
A comment, even if empty, should not be null for record-keeping purposes.
The HoodieEngineContext is required for execution, so it should not be null at method exit.
